title: Preparation of Genomic DNA of Microsporidia
author: ShiNan Dong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.igacbse

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA from Microsporidia
steps.instruction: Isolate genomic DNA from purified microsporidia spores using a KOH-based lysis and proteinase K digestion method.

substeps.instruction: Mix 400 μl of purified spore suspension (10^10 spores/ml) with 40 μl of 2 mol/l KOH in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Incubate the mixture at 27°C to 76°C for 1 hour.
Add TEK buffer (1 mmol/l Tris–HCl, 10 mmol/l EDTA, 0.17 mol/l KCl, pH 8.0) and continue incubating at 27°C to 76°C for 1 hour.
Adjust the pH to 8.0 using 1 mol/l HCl.
Add 10% SDS to achieve a final concentration of 0.5% in the mixture and keep on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 20 mg/ml proteinase K (TaKaRa Biotechnology Co. LTD) to achieve a final concentration of 200 μg/ml in the mixture and incubate at 50°C to 76°C for 4 hours.
Wash the extract with chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1 v/v).
Centrifuge at 10,000 r/min for 5 minutes, recover the aqueous phase, and add 10% NaOAC.
Precipitate DNA by adding 2.5 times volume of cold ethanol at -20°C for 40 minutes, then centrifuge at 12,000 r/min for 10 minutes.
Rinse the precipitated DNA twice with 500 μl cold 70% ethanol.
Dry the DNA at 37°C to 76°C for 5–10 minutes.
Dissolve the DNA in 50 μl TE buffer at 65°C to 76°C for 10 minutes and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Amplify SSU rRNA Gene via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the SSU rRNA genes using specific primers and a defined thermal cycling profile.

substeps.instruction: Use the following primer set: Forward 5'-CACCAGGTTGATTCTGCC-3' and Reverse 5'-TTATGATCCTGCTAATGGTTC-3'.
Perform initial denaturation at 94°C for 8 minutes.
Run 28 cycles of: 94°C for 1 minute, 43°C for 1 minute 40 seconds, and 72°C for 1 minute 40 seconds.
Perform a final extension at 72°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Clone and Sequence PCR Products
steps.instruction: Clone the amplified SSU rRNA gene products into a vector for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Clone the PCR amplified products into the pGEM-T vector.
Perform sequencing of the cloned products.
